svg.text: NVIDIA CUDA Tile - cuTile Python + CUDA Tile C++ - Tile IR Virtual ISA - CUDA 13.1+
L1 - Applications + Integration (tile-based AI/ML kernels - TileGym examples)
L2 - Dual Language Frontends (shared Tile IR backend - complementary to SIMT CUDA path)
Triple-chevron launch grid, 1 - integrate C++ codebases
Grid of tile blocks - 1 logical thread per block
Compiler maps intra-block parallelism to HW threads
Not either/or - tile path coexists with SIMT/PTX
Tile IR is to tiles what PTX is to SIMT threads
L3 - Kernel API + Tile Primitives (compile-time tile shapes - value-semantics tiles)
L4 - CUDA Tile IR (portable tile virtual ISA - foundation of CUDA Tile programming model)
Models GPU as tile processor not SIMT threads
Each logical thread = one tile block
Operates on tile fragments of tensors
Interops with CUDA C++ and PTX
Map tiles to threads within each block
Lower tile-space loads to TMA when supported
MLIR dialect for compilers targeting Tile IR
Helion TileIR backend can bridge here
Array: global memory - strided - all blocks
OOB: padding on load - discard on store
L5 - tileiras Compiler + JIT Specialization (per shape/dtype config - optimization hints)
Specialize per tile shape + dtype + constants
ct.Constant[T] embeds literals at compile time
L6 - Lowering + CUDA Runtime (Tile IR to PTX to SASS - launch on CUDA stream)
Parallel path alongside SIMT PTX in CTK
PTX to SASS machine code for target SM
Nsight Compute profiles cuTile like SIMT
CUDA Array Interface for device arrays
L7 - Target Hardware (sm80+ Ampere and newer - Tensor Cores + TMA auto-selected)
@ct.kernel Python/C++ - Tile IR - tileiras optimize - PTX - SASS - ct.launch on stream
Stage 1 Author: @ct.kernel body - ct.load/store/mma - ct.bid tile-space indexing
Stage 2 Lower: Python/C++ frontend emits Tile IR bytecode (JIT per shape/dtype/constants)
Stage 3 Optimize: tileiras applies hints - TMA lowering - occupancy - thread mapping
Stage 4 Codegen: Tile IR to PTX via tileiras - ptxas/libnvvm to target SASS
Stage 5 Launch: ct.launch(stream, grid, kernel, args) - Tensor Core/TMA on sm80+ GPU
Example GEMM: partition_view - K-loop ct.mma(a,b,acc) FP32 acc - store_masked edge tiles
Design Position: Official NVIDIA Tile Path in CUDA Stack
Tile IR virtual ISA parallel to PTX - compiler owns thread/mem/TensorCore mapping
Official Tile IR + tileiras in CTK
Virtual ISA like PTX for tiles
CUDA Software Stack (Figure 2 from NVIDIA blog)
App - cuTile Python/C++ - Tile IR - tileiras - PTX - Driver (parallel to CUDA C++ SIMT path)
MLIR dialect enables future DSLs - Helion TileIR - custom frameworks targeting Tile IR
Design Position (NVIDIA official tile programming model - raise abstraction above SIMT for Tensor Core workloads)
Write tile ops not threads - Tile IR portability - tileiras maps to TMA/TensorCore - coexists with PTX SIMT
